symbols.name: signed dimension change
symbols.meaning: The change in label dimension along an edge from tail label U to head label U', negative on a decreasing edge.
symbols.quote: Its signed change is $\Delta=\dim U'-\dim U$, the dimension of the head label minus that of the tail label.

symbols.name: source dimension total
symbols.meaning: The sum of the dimensions of the source labels of the network.
symbols.quote: Let $\mu$ be the sum of the source dimensions (this letter changes meaning here; the paper calls it $N$).

symbols.name: lost dimension
symbols.meaning: The total dimension lost along decreasing edges, summed over all such edges.
symbols.quote: Let $\mathcal{L}$ be the total dimension lost along decreasing edges, those whose head label is smaller than their tail label.

symbols.name: call parameter
symbols.meaning: The parameter of a call, which counts the selected axes of a numerical layer or the digits of an address field.
symbols.quote: The parameter $e$ counts the selected axes of a [numerical layer](numerical-layer.md), or the digits of an address field.

symbols.name: cost per unit volume
symbols.meaning: The cost of a call at parameter e divided by its volume.
symbols.quote: Let $\delta(e)$ be the cost of a call at parameter $e$ divided by its volume.

symbols.name: power-saving exponent
symbols.meaning: The exponent log base m of s/W, so that the cost per unit of data is about e to the power tau.

relations.quote: Rank-saving recursion counts smaller calls on the wires of the [subset-intersection network](subset-intersection-network.md), whose wires carry scalars.
Each call splits into smaller calls to the [address-field interchange](address-interchange.md), each on one role stream of $V/W$ bits.
The parameter $e$ counts the selected axes of a [numerical layer](numerical-layer.md), or the digits of an address field.
Rank-saving recursion gives each smaller call one such [role stream](stream.md).

The signed sum of dimension changes telescopes over the incidences of each gate: every [incidence](incidence.md) of one gate carries the same label, so the edge entering a gate and the edge leaving it share that label.
The recursion is counted for the [complex construction](complex-construction.md) as $s=Wm-2\mu+2\mathcal{L}$.

The recursion is also counted for the [bit construction](bit-construction.md) as $s=Wm-\mu+2\mathcal{L}$, because each of the $\mu$ first-stage source edges has rational rank one although its dimension change is zero.
